bear_case: The DXY remains the gating risk. Three days of US market closure (Juneteenth + Saturday) have allowed DXY to drift from 101.13 to 100.23 on thin weekend FX — this is not the same as a confirmed US session close below 100.00. Monday June 22 brings the first full-participation session since June 18. If Fed speakers (scheduled June 22-26 calendar) reinforce the 60.7% October rate-hike probability in their post-Juneteenth appearances, DXY could reverse the weekend decline and re-test 101+, closing ALL three conditional-add gates simultaneously. The bear case for Monday: DXY opens above 100.50 as hawkish positioning re-establishes after the holiday break → NVDA conditional add postponed → BTC macro gate stays closed → 30Y test of 5.00% materializes before PCE on June 25. SPCX IG ratings are a fundamental positive but equities in the highest-multiple segment can still selloff in a risk-off DXY-rising scenario even with IG endorsement. Invalidation of the bear case: DXY confirms below 100.00 on Monday June 22 close AND SPX holds 7,460 → HOLD confirmed across all assets, NVDA conditional add executes. DXY below 99.00 → BUY upgrade.
